isRFP.description: 'true' if this is an RFP / RFQ / tender; else 'false'.

reply.description: What to say next to the visitor. Two or three sentences, warm and professional, at most one question.

floors.description: Number of floors, as given. Empty if not given.

urgency.description: Urgency expressed by the visitor, such as emergency, urgent, this week, next week, or other timing language. Capture exactly as stated. Empty if none.

complete.description: 'true' ONLY once you have ALL of: company name, service wanted, site city, contact NAME, and a valid company/business contact EMAIL. Otherwise 'false'. These are exactly the fields the server requires to open a Lead.

siteCity.description: City / town / region of the site(s). Capture exactly as provided. Empty if not given.

siteType.description: Type of premises, such as office, retail, medical, educational, industrial, warehouse, hotel, hospitality, mixed-use, etc. Empty if not given.

frequency.description: Frequency wanted, per service if multiple. Example: 'janitorial 3x/week, windows 1x/week'. Preserve each service and its frequency. Empty if not given.

clientType.description: commercial | other. This company sells to businesses only; there is no residential intake. Infer silently; do not ask unless genuinely unclear. Empty if unknown.

leadSource.description: Original source or channel of the enquiry, such as website, website chat, email, RFQ email, phone, manual entry, API, webhook, or other configured source. Capture the source when available. Never guess.

outOfScope.description: 'true' if the request is only for services this company does NOT offer, or if the enquiry is from a private householder. Judge this against the SERVICE SCOPE block supplied with the conversation — never against your own assumption, and never guess when no scope block was supplied.

companyName.description: MANDATORY. Business / company name. The server refuses a Lead without one, so never set complete = 'true' until it is known. Empty only if still unknown.

contactName.description: MANDATORY. Name of the contact person. Keep asking until provided; empty only if still unknown.

contactRole.description: Role of the contact in the organisation, if stated, such as decision maker, facility manager, procurement, operations, commercial, site contact, influencer, or other. Do not guess. Empty if not provided.

description.description: A short, useful summary of the whole enquiry for the office. Include the company, sites, services, frequencies, facility type, area, surfaces, deadlines, urgency and special requirements when available.

rfpDeadline.description: The RFP / RFQ / bid / tender / walkthrough deadline exactly as stated by the visitor or contained in the enquiry. Never convert or invent. Empty if none.

roomDetails.description: Rooms / areas and counts, such as '3 offices, 1 operating room'. Capture only what is provided. Empty if not given.

serviceType.description: The cleaning or facility service(s) wanted. List all mentioned services, such as janitorial, floor care, carpet, window cleaning, power washing, disinfection, post-construction, exterior maintenance, etc. Empty if unknown.

siteAddress.description: Full street address of the site if provided. Do not guess or construct an address. Empty if not given.

contactEmail.description: MANDATORY. Contact email exactly as given. It must be a company/business email. Personal domains such as gmail, yahoo, hotmail, outlook, icloud, aol, live and msn are not accepted as the final contact email. Keep asking for a business email until provided.

contactPhone.description: Phone number exactly as given. Empty if not given.

surfaceTypes.description: Floor / surface types such as carpet, tile, marble, wood, concrete, glass, etc., as given. Empty if not given.

numberOfSites.description: How many sites / locations are in scope, such as '1', '5 offices', or '20 stores'. Capture exactly as provided. Empty if not given.

squareFootage.description: Size of the site(s) in square feet, exactly as given. Preserve approximate wording such as 'around 100,000 sq ft'. NEVER guess.

companyWebsite.description: Company website or domain if provided or available from the enquiry. Empty if not known. NEVER guess.

preferredTiming.description: Any timing the visitor states, including preferred walkthrough time, preferred visit time, service start date, or other timing. Capture EXACTLY as said. Never convert or invent. Empty if none.

walkthroughNeeded.description: 'true' if a site survey / walkthrough is explicitly requested or clearly expected; otherwise 'false' or empty. Do not promise or schedule the walkthrough.

specialRequirements.description: Special requirements such as green cleaning, insurance, MSA, COI, day vs night service, access constraints, security requirements, emergency requirements, compliance requirements, or other special instructions. Empty if none.

preferredContactMethod.description: email | phone | either, if stated by the visitor. Empty if not given.
